attBesluta.text: Bought this for an air fryer oven with limited size. This Dutch oven is perfect. Fits with the lid on and works great. Great quality and price. Came with lots of goodies too.

I bought this 36-quart stainless steel stockpot for preparing soups, pasta, and large meals. The size is perfect for cooking for groups, and the included basket makes draining food much easier. The stainless steel construction feels solid, and it heats evenly on my stove. The price is reasonable for what you get, although the finish could be a little better. It is easy to clean after use, and the handles provide a secure grip even when the pot is full. Overall, this is a practical and reliable stockpot for home or light commercial use. It is not premium quality, but it performs well and offers good value for the money. I would recommend it to anyone who needs a large-capacity cooking pot without spending too much.

It's easily and by far the sturdiest keyboard tray I've ever used, though still it's a bit fiddly for my taste. I was under the impression it would be rock solid which it isn't. Due to my effort to completely stabilize it I broke the tightening screw. But still the tray is very useable, and the range of adjustment is quite wide and diverse. It slides, tilts, rotates and goes up and down so you will most likely find a comfortable position.

Bought 3 of these for my daughters and my daughter-in-law. Not made of cedar, so how long they will last remains to be seen. Assembly was ok after figuring out the first one. Vevor is a coin toss; if you get a product that is all there and works, you're all set. But if you need parts or expect top-notch customer service, forget it. This product is good.
